x: Early in November, on a Wednesday afternoon, nearly 400 boys managed to change in our Headquarters and compete in two races for the South London Schools Championships, and the Shields given by our Vice President, Mr.

RYAN in providing a further Shield - the Belgrave Shield - for competition in the cross-country Championships promoted by the South London School Association. Thus all three groups into which schoolboys are now divided have a trophy thro' the Belgrave Harriers, at the expense of Eddie Ryan.

The whole meeting was suitably rounded off by a typical gesture of our "A.A.A's" timekeeper E. Ryan who by sleight of hand produced two aircraft construction kits to be added to the prize list for the younger athletes.

We shall soon be losing the services of Eddie RYAN who on retirement, is to take up residence in Malta. We shall greatly miss his help of our Grade I Timekeeper, and thank him most sincerely for all he has done for us over many years.
